development_set: Previously observed 217 MMLU dev/validation questions: 75 specialized and 142 general
audit_set: Pre-fixed 160 previously unused questions; specialized audit scope is statistics only
selection_metric: 0.65 * specialized development accuracy + 0.35 * general development accuracy
general_constraint: General development accuracy must be at least baseline 73/142 minus 0.02
sft_requirement: Final submission must include a fine-tuned adapter; unchanged base is a comparison or ensemble component only
inference_candidates: base/final/narrow crossed with boxed/direct/answer/raw and original/cyclic option order
training_candidates: New five-choice mixture; label-only LoRA lr=5e-5; epochs 1 and 2; boxed original/cyclic inference
ensemble_candidates: Equal probability averages of old base+narrow, base+final, base+narrow+final; also base+best new training checkpoint
audit_policy: Select using development results, then evaluate the selected pipeline once on the new audit set against the previous submitted model and unchanged base. Do not retune on audit or course/Kaggle scores.
submission_policy: Preserve submission.csv; write submission_v2.csv using selected pipeline. No guarantee of higher Kaggle score.
